status: Baseline ownership contract; independent split schematics now exist, copper migration pending

prototype_scope.decision: User accepts possible child-board damage after an internal cable disconnect; disconnect, partial-insertion and open-return fault survival are outside prototype acceptance.
prototype_scope.retained_requirements: Normal connected operation, startup/shutdown with cables attached, USB/source limits, regeneration, cable ampacity and signal integrity

signal_harness.status: Prototype header selected; connected-operation cable construction, orientation and current review remain open

candidate_cable.status: Trial candidate only: nominal fit, strip-length and width/span tolerances do not fully meet FH12 recommendation; sample or alternate cable required before order

signal_harness.length_status: Unverified target; requires mechanical and signal-integrity review
signal_harness.orientation_contract: Both component sides up, bottom-contact headers facing one another, same-side-contact FFC without twist: main J8.n to wheel J9.(31-n). Main odd contacts GND; wheel even contacts GND.

power_harness.status: Candidate only; final current budget and cable/connector acceptance pending
power_harness.prototype_wire: AWG22, two conductors; no live mating
power_harness.rating_wire: AWG22 per JST PA family specification; rating is not a design-current approval

encoder.connection: Keep main J6 to encoder J7 directly; do not carry encoder SPI through wheel harness

wheel.status: 87 footprints; local power/brake/phase/ADC2 analog routing and saved ground checks pass; 61 connections remain; digital routing, mounts and mechanical fit pending

panel.status: Nesting study; support web, routed slots, tabs, fiducials and tooling are not designed
